glossary.definition: A friendly greeting meaning 'Good morning' or 'Hello'.
glossary.example: Bonjour, comment ça va? — Hello, how are you?

glossary.definition: A word meaning 'Thank you'. You say it when someone helps you.
glossary.example: Merci beaucoup! — Thank you very much!

glossary.definition: A polite phrase meaning 'Please'. Used when asking for something.
glossary.example: Un livre, s'il vous plaît — A book, please.

glossary.definition: A phrase meaning 'My name is'. Used to introduce yourself.
glossary.example: Je m'appelle Kofi — My name is Kofi.
Comment ça va? — Ça va bien! (How are you? — I'm fine!)

glossary.definition: A phrase meaning 'Goodbye'. Said when leaving.
glossary.example: Au revoir, à demain! — Goodbye, see you tomorrow!
J'ai un livre — I have a book.
Je vais à l'école — I go to school.
Le professeur enseigne — The teacher teaches.

glossary.definition: The French words for the numbers one, two and three.
glossary.example: Un, deux, trois, quatre — One, two, three, four.
Aujourd'hui il fait beau — Today the weather is nice.

glossary.definition: The French word meaning 'morning' or 'in the morning'.
glossary.example: Je me lève le matin — I wake up in the morning.

glossary.definition: A polite phrase meaning 'Excuse me'. Used when you need to apologize or get someone's attention.
glossary.example: Excusez-moi, où est la gare? — Excuse me, where is the station?

glossary.definition: A polite expression meaning 'Nice to meet you'. Said when you meet someone for the first time.
glossary.example: Enchanté, je suis Ama! — Nice to meet you, I am Ama!
J'ai un stylo bleu — I have a blue pen.
Le cahier est sur la table — The notebook is on the table.

glossary.definition: The word for 'bedroom' or 'room' in French.
glossary.example: Ma chambre est grande — My bedroom is big.
Mon père est enseignant — My father is a teacher.
Ma mère cuisine bien — My mother cooks well.
Mon frère a huit ans — My brother is eight years old.
Ma sœur va à l'école — My sister goes to school.
Kofi est mon ami — Kofi is my friend.
L'enfant joue dans le jardin — The child plays in the garden.
Je bois de l'eau — I drink water.
Je mange du pain — I eat bread.
Le riz est chaud — The rice is hot.
Les fruits sont bons pour la santé — Fruits are good for health.
Les légumes sont verts — The vegetables are green.
Je prends le petit-déjeuner à sept heures — I have breakfast at seven o'clock.
Nous mangeons le déjeuner à midi — We eat lunch at noon.

glossary.definition: The word for 'dinner' or 'supper' in French.
glossary.example: Le dîner est prêt — Dinner is ready.
J'ai mal à la tête — My head hurts.
Lave tes mains — Wash your hands.
Le pied est grand — The foot is big.

glossary.definition: The word for 'eye' in French. The plural is 'les yeux'.
glossary.example: Il a les yeux bleus — He has blue eyes.
Mon nez est petit — My nose is small.
Ouvre la bouche — Open your mouth.
Il a de grandes oreilles — He has big ears.
La pomme est rouge — The apple is red.
Le ciel est bleu — The sky is blue.
L'herbe est verte — The grass is green.
Le soleil est jaune — The sun is yellow.
Le chat est noir — The cat is black.
La neige est blanche — The snow is white.

glossary.definition: The French words for the numbers ten, eleven and twelve.
glossary.example: Dix, onze, douze, treize — Ten, eleven, twelve, thirteen.

glossary.definition: The French words for Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday.
glossary.example: Nous allons à l'école du lundi au vendredi — We go to school from Monday to Friday.

glossary.definition: A common verb meaning 'to be'. Used to describe who or what someone is.
glossary.example: Je suis étudiant — I am a student.

glossary.definition: A common verb meaning 'to have'. Used to show possession.
glossary.example: J'ai un chat — I have a cat.

glossary.definition: A common verb meaning 'to do' or 'to make'.
glossary.example: Il fait beau — The weather is nice.

glossary.definition: The French word meaning 'evening' or 'in the evening'.
glossary.example: Je lis le soir — I read in the evening.

questions.question: Which French word means 'Hello' or 'Good morning'?
questions.explanation: Bonjour is the friendly greeting that means 'Hello' or 'Good morning'.

questions.question: You want to say 'Thank you' in French. Which word do you use?
questions.explanation: Merci means 'Thank you'.

questions.question: Which French phrase means 'Please'?
questions.explanation: S'il vous plaît is the polite way to say 'Please' when asking for something.

questions.question: To introduce yourself you say '___ Kofi' (My name is Kofi). Which phrase fits?
questions.explanation: Je m'appelle means 'My name is'. You use it to introduce yourself.

questions.question: It's time to leave. What do you say in French?
questions.explanation: Au revoir means 'Goodbye', said when you leave.

questions.question: Which French word means 'book'?
questions.explanation: Le livre is the French word for 'book'.

questions.question: Which word means 'school'?
questions.explanation: L'école means 'school'.

questions.question: Which French word means 'Excuse me'?
questions.explanation: Excusez-moi means 'Excuse me'. You use it to apologize or get attention.

questions.question: Which word means 'pen' in French?
questions.explanation: Le stylo is the French word for 'pen'.

questions.question: What is the French word for 'notebook'?
questions.explanation: Le cahier means 'notebook'.

questions.question: Which French word means 'father'?
questions.explanation: Le père means 'father'.

questions.question: The word for 'mother' in French is ___.
questions.explanation: La mère is the French word for 'mother'.

questions.question: Which word means 'brother' in French?
questions.explanation: Le frère means 'brother'.

questions.question: 'La sœur' means ___.
questions.explanation: La sœur is the French word for 'sister'.

questions.question: Which French word means 'water'?
questions.explanation: L'eau means 'water'.

questions.question: What is the French word for 'bread'?
questions.explanation: Le pain is the French word for 'bread'.

questions.question: 'La main' is the French word for ___.
questions.explanation: La main means 'hand'.

questions.question: Which word means 'foot' in French?
questions.explanation: Le pied means 'foot'.

questions.question: What is the French word for 'nose'?
questions.explanation: Le nez is the French word for 'nose'.

questions.question: Which color means 'red' in French?
questions.explanation: Rouge means 'red'.

questions.question: 'Bleu' is the French word for ___.
questions.explanation: Bleu means 'blue'.

questions.question: Which color means 'green' in French?
questions.explanation: Vert means 'green'.

questions.question: What is the French word for 'yellow'?
questions.explanation: Jaune means 'yellow'.

questions.question: How do you say 'one, two, three' in French?
questions.explanation: Un, deux, trois is French for one, two, three.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: 'J'ai un ___' (I have a book).
questions.explanation: Le livre means 'book', so 'J'ai un livre' means 'I have a book'.

questions.question: 'Comment ça va?' means ___.
questions.explanation: Comment ça va? is the question 'How are you?'.

questions.question: Which French word means 'today'?
questions.explanation: Aujourd'hui means 'today'.

questions.question: Which French expression means 'in the morning'?
questions.explanation: Le matin means 'morning' or 'in the morning'.

questions.question: 'Enchanté' is used when ___.
options: meeting someone for the first time
questions.correctAnswer: meeting someone for the first time
questions.explanation: Enchanté means 'Nice to meet you' and is used when meeting someone new.

questions.question: What does 'La chambre' mean in English?
questions.explanation: La chambre means 'bedroom' or 'room'.

questions.question: 'L'ami' means ___.
questions.explanation: L'ami is the French word for 'friend' (male).

questions.question: What is the French word for 'child'?
questions.explanation: L'enfant means 'child'.

questions.question: What is the French word for 'rice'?
questions.explanation: Le riz is the French word for 'rice'.

questions.question: 'Les fruits' means ___.
questions.explanation: Les fruits means 'fruits' in French.

questions.question: What is the French word for 'breakfast'?
questions.explanation: Le petit-déjeuner means 'breakfast'.

questions.question: 'Le déjeuner' is the French word for ___.
questions.explanation: Le déjeuner means 'lunch'.

questions.question: What does 'La tête' mean?
questions.explanation: La tête means 'head'.

questions.question: Fill in: 'Ouvre la ___' (Open your mouth).
questions.explanation: La bouche means 'mouth', so 'Ouvre la bouche' means 'Open your mouth'.

questions.question: Which color means 'black' in French?
questions.explanation: Noir means 'black'.

questions.question: 'Blanc' means ___ in English.
questions.explanation: Blanc means 'white'.

questions.question: 'Le soir' means ___.
questions.explanation: Le soir means 'in the evening'.

questions.question: Fill in: 'Je vais à l'___' (I go to school).
questions.explanation: L'école means 'school', so 'Je vais à l'école' means 'I go to school'.

questions.question: True or false: 'Le professeur' means 'the teacher'.
questions.explanation: Le professeur is the French word for 'the teacher'.

questions.question: You see a 'stylo' on the desk. What is it?
questions.explanation: Le stylo means 'pen'.

questions.question: A doctor checks your 'pied'. Which body part is this?
questions.explanation: Le pied means 'foot'.

questions.question: What is the French word for 'vegetables'?
questions.explanation: Les légumes means 'vegetables' in French.

questions.question: 'Le dîner' means ___.
questions.explanation: Le dîner means 'dinner' or 'supper'.

questions.question: What is the French word for 'ear'?
questions.explanation: L'oreille is the French word for 'ear'.

questions.question: 'L'œil' is the French word for ___.
questions.explanation: L'œil means 'eye'. The plural is 'les yeux'.

questions.question: Which numbers mean 'ten, eleven, twelve' in French?
questions.explanation: Dix means ten, onze means eleven, douze means twelve.

questions.question: 'Lundi, mardi, mercredi' means ___.
questions.explanation: Lundi is Monday, mardi is Tuesday, mercredi is Wednesday.

questions.question: Which verb means 'to be' in French?
questions.explanation: Être is the French verb meaning 'to be'. For example, 'Je suis' means 'I am'.

questions.question: Fill in: 'Je ___ un chat' (I have a cat).
questions.explanation: Avoir means 'to have'. The conjugated form for 'je' is 'ai', so 'J'ai un chat' means 'I have a cat'.

questions.question: Which verb means 'to do' or 'to make' in French?
questions.explanation: Faire is the French verb meaning 'to do' or 'to make'.

questions.question: Translate: 'Il fait beau aujourd'hui.'
questions.explanation: 'Il fait beau' is an expression using 'faire' that means 'the weather is nice'.

questions.question: What is the opposite of 'noir' (black) in French?
questions.explanation: Noir means black and blanc means white — they are opposites.

questions.question: 'Le petit-déjeuner' is eaten at what time of day?
questions.explanation: Le petit-déjeuner means 'breakfast', which is eaten in the morning.

questions.question: Translate: 'L'enfant joue dans le jardin.'
options: The child plays in the garden
The woman reads in the kitchen
The man walks in the park
questions.correctAnswer: The child plays in the garden
questions.explanation: L'enfant = the child, joue = plays, dans = in, le jardin = the garden.

questions.question: Translate: 'Le chat est noir.'
questions.explanation: Le chat = the cat, est = is, noir = black.

questions.question: Fill in: 'Il ___ un étudiant' (He is a student).
questions.explanation: Être means 'to be'. The conjugated form for 'il' is 'est', so 'Il est un étudiant' means 'He is a student'.
